concepts.description: The inequality |<u,v>| ≤ ||u||·||v|| for vectors in an inner product space, used in Problem 5 to derive the triangle inequality.
concepts.name: Cauchy-Schwarz Inequality

concepts.description: The inner product of two vectors, a·b = Σ aᵢbᵢ, which underpins the proofs in Problems 1 and 3 and links to the geometry of angles and lengths.
concepts.name: Dot Product

concepts.description: The relation c² = a² + b² − 2ab·cos(θ) relating the sides of a triangle to one of its angles, proved in Problem 1 using vectors and the dot product.
concepts.name: Law of Cosines

concepts.description: The fact that ||u + v|| ≤ ||u|| + ||v||, which Problem 5 proves by applying the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality.
concepts.name: Triangle Inequality

concepts.description: A square matrix Q with QᵀQ = I, whose preservation of the Euclidean inner product is shown in Problem 3.
concepts.name: Orthogonal Matrix

concepts.description: The formula sin(a+b) = sin a·cos b + cos a·sin b, derived in Problem 2.
concepts.name: Trigonometric Angle-Addition Identity

concepts.description: A binary operation on vectors in three-dimensional space whose anti-commutativity is examined in Problem 4.
concepts.name: Cross Product

concepts.description: The property that swapping the operands changes only the sign, a×b = −(b×a), which Problem 4 proves for the cross product.
concepts.name: Anti-Commutativity
